title: Crosshair - Petal
description: A soft, petal-inspired crosshair with a delicate aesthetic that keeps your aim clean ꕤ
body:
A tiny crosshair pack made for the girls who love soft, dreamy details ✧

This pack adds a soft, Petal-inspired crosshair designed to be clean, visible, and effortlessly pretty. Perfect for players who love an aesthetic touch while keeping their gameplay clear.
